cand.title: IEEE Quantum Week 2026
cand.excerpt: Nine-day Toronto conference period with official discounted group rates at Union Hotel and Delta Hotels Toronto, including a sold-out date at Delta and multiple recommended downtown hotels; supports guestroom, meeting, catering and AV demand in the hotel’s immediate market.
cand.selectionWhy: Prior blocked-promising candidate (no exact date/contact in thin ledger)

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Carmen Saliba, IEEE Computer Society, QCE20–26 Event Manager, is the primary operational relationship contact. Silvia Ceballos, IEEE Computer Society Director, Conference Operations, is the second relevant conference-operations contact. Their roles are published on the QCE26 organizing committee. Relevance to housing routing is an inference; neither is proven to hold hotel contracting authority or a QCE27 appointment.
findings.futureEdition: Next officially announced edition: IEEE Quantum Week 2027 (8th annual QCE), October 10–15, 2027, Atlantic Union Bank Convention Center, Raleigh, North Carolina, USA. This is within December 6, 2026–June 2028 but outside the Toronto hotel territory. No official 2028 edition or Toronto return was found as of November 15, 2026.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: a 157-room downtown Harbourfront hotel is a plausible overflow/speaker/VIP lodging or small ancillary-meeting option for a future Toronto edition, not the main venue or exclusive housing for a conference reporting 2,307 registrants. A 15–109 peak-room sales scenario is only a hotel-capacity planning range, not published event demand. The 240-theatre ballroom cannot accommodate the full conference. City-convention access fits the 2026 format better than positioning this as a resort/incentive programme. No current Toronto demand arises from the announced Raleigh 2027 edition. Do not promise catering, restaurant/lounge service or AV without separate hotel confirmation.
findings.venueCommitments: QCE26 took place September 13–18, 2026 at Metro Toronto Convention Centre – South, Toronto, Ontario, Canada: Toronto proper, downtown/MTCC, not a suburban venue. The operational speaker guide explicitly specifies South; the hotel-recommendations PDF uses the general MTCC address 255 Front St W, so do not use that PDF to identify the meeting entrance. QCE27 is officially announced at Atlantic Union Bank Convention Center in Raleigh, North Carolina, USA. These are published venue selections, not inspected signed contracts.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: 2020 virtual (original Broomfield/Omni Interlocken plan canceled); 2021 virtual (original Broomfield plan); 2022 Omni Interlocken, Broomfield; 2023 Hyatt Regency Bellevue, Bellevue; 2024 Palais des congrès de Montréal, Montréal; 2025 Albuquerque Convention Center, Albuquerque; 2026 MTCC South, Toronto; announced 2027 Raleigh. This demonstrates recurrence and destination rotation, not an annual Toronto event or a fixed resort preference.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2026 lodging was attendee booking through edition-specific hotel group-rate links, plus recommendations—not an evidenced exclusive housing bureau. Official wording: “Book your group rate for 2026 IEEE Quantum Week.” Union Hotel Toronto: CAD 529.00++ per night, booking stay window September 10–18, 2026. Delta Hotels Toronto – Marriott Hotel: CAD 475.00 plus taxes per night, booking stay window September 10–19; “Please note this hotel is SOLD OUT on Tuesday, September 15”; cutoff August 21, 2026, 5PM EST. Those are accommodation windows, not nine days of conference activity. Other listed hotels, recommendations only: Chelsea Hotel Toronto; Toronto Don Valley Hotel and Suites; Monte Carlo Inn Vaughan Suites; Holiday Inn Express Toronto-North York; Novotel Toronto North York; Toronto Marriott Markham; Delta Hotels Toronto Airport & Conference Centre. The PDF says “All rates are approximate and subject to change” and recommends the Destination Toronto hotel aggregator; that does not establish a contracted housing bureau or blocks at these seven hotels. Recommendations include suburban locations, not just downtown. No QCE27 hotel blocks, housing provider or open hotel RFP were located.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-led technical conference, not a corporate incentive programme. IEEE is a not-for-profit professional association; QCE is IEEE Quantum Week’s formal conference identity. The published operational committee includes IEEE Computer Society staff. MTCC is the historical venue; the named hotels are lodging suppliers. No external PCO, DMC or exclusive housing bureau was identified in the reviewed edition-specific material.
findings.competitiveLimitations: 2026 official group-rate paths favoured Union Hotel Toronto and Delta Hotels Toronto; Radisson Blu was not listed. Delta’s September 15 sell-out is specific historical compression evidence, not proof of unserved demand, Radisson pickup, a citywide sell-out or a future overflow allocation. Seven alternative hotel recommendations were also published. No block sizes, pickup, peak rooms or room nights were found. The reported 2,307 registrants are not 2,307 hotel guests: the event had a virtual component.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Do not create a dated Toronto sales opportunity for QCE27. Approach Carmen Saliba first, with Silvia Ceballos as the conference-operations escalation, to ask whether Toronto is under consideration beyond Raleigh, who manages hotel procurement, whether independent overflow hotels can participate, and when a Toronto housing decision would be made. Offer a capacity-limited overflow/VIP proposition only if a Toronto cycle is confirmed. Request historical Toronto block/pickup data rather than extrapolating from registrations or the Delta sell-out.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: QCE26 Toronto is past as of November 15, 2026 and cannot be sold as an upcoming stay opportunity. The September 10–19 accommodation window must not be promoted as the event dates. QCE27 is confirmed in Raleigh, so it is not actionable Toronto room demand. No evidence supports an open Toronto sourcing process.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain as a low-priority association relationship, conditional on a future Toronto bid or announced return. Multi-city recurrence supports monitoring, not presumed Toronto business. A future Toronto edition could justify a limited overflow/VIP block and side-meeting proposal; there is no sourced 2028 destination, Toronto return, open RFP or room allocation.
